verdict.rationale: Meltano's own documented self-hosted deployment model lets users run everything on their own servers, which puts the storage location under their control. Its connectors also load data into any destination the user picks. There is no explicit region or data-residency documentation, and the managed offering, where Meltano hosts everything, shows no region selection. missing for 10: explicit data-residency/region documentation, region choice for the Meltano-hosted offering, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You host and manage everything on your own servers
Own every part of your data infrastructure, on your own servers, free forever.
Build your own Meltano connector to move data from any source to any destination.
